get.summary: Latest observations for supported FRED macroeconomic series
get.description: Returns up to two latest numeric observations per requested series from the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED API. Requires FRED_API_KEY in the deployed environment. This route currently has no x402 payment middleware confirmed; the OpenAPI security declaration is therefore empty.

parameters.name: series
parameters.description: Comma-separated FRED series IDs. Supported IDs: DFF (Federal Funds Effective Rate), DGS10 (10-Year Treasury Constant Maturity Rate), CPIAUCSL (CPI for All Urban Consumers), PCEPI (Personal Consumption Expenditures Price Index), UNRATE (Unemployment Rate), GDP (Gross Domestic Product). Defaults to DFF,DGS10,CPIAUCSL,UNRATE.
